problem_statement.task: Verify basic page load and rendering
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Navigate to the generated website's URL. 2. Wait for the page to fully load. 3. Check the console for any errors. 4. Verify that the main layout structure (sidebar and main content area) is visible.
problem_statement.expected_result: The page loads without crashing, no blocking errors are in the console, and the main layout structure is present.
problem_statement.criteria: Pass if the page loads and the basic layout structure is visible with no critical console errors. Fail otherwise.

problem_statement.task: Verify navigation link clickability and state changes
problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Locate the sidebar navigation menu. 2. Click on the 'Getting Involved' link. 3. Observe the URL and page content change. 4. Click back to 'HOMEPAGE' and observe the change.
problem_statement.expected_result: Clicking navigation links updates the main content area to reflect the corresponding page (e.g., changing from the homepage text to the 'Getting Involved' text and image) without full page reloads if implemented as an SPA, or correctly routes if multi-page.
problem_statement.criteria: Pass if clicking 'Getting Involved' updates the content to match the involvement.php.png content and URL structure changes appropriately. Deduct 5 points if content updates but styling breaks. Fail if links are not clickable or don't change content.

problem_statement.operation_sequence: 1. Scroll to the footer of the page. 2. Locate the 'Click HERE to Email Us' link. 3. Inspect the link's `href` attribute using DevTools. 4. Click the link.
problem_statement.expected_result: The link should have a `mailto:` href attribute, attempting to open the default email client.
problem_statement.criteria: Pass if the href contains 'mailto:'. Fail if it is a dead link ('#') or navigates away incorrectly.

problem_statement.task: Verify visual fidelity of the Homepage layout
Verify visual fidelity of the Homepage active states and highlighting
Verify visual fidelity of the Getting Involved page content
Verify sidebar background gradient and overall typography
